policy_notes.note: HUD 2026 Budget Management Letter: vouchers are funding-constrained. PHAs asked to stop issuing new vouchers (except HUD-VASH and FYI), pause new project-based voucher commitments, and cut payment standards, ending exception payment standards and staying inside the 90-110% basic range. Expect payment standards toward the low end of the range.
NSPIRE inspections for vouchers delayed to 2027-02-01 (third extension). Until then PHAs may still inspect under the old HQS (24 CFR 982.401). The checklist here aims at both.

Emergency Housing Vouchers are ending: families under EHV HAP contracts on 2026-09-30 move to Tenant Protection Vouchers by 2026-12-31 (PIH 2026-25); closeout from early 2027. For a landlord the lease continues as an ordinary voucher.
PHAs may use HCV admin fees for landlord signing/retention bonuses, security and utility deposits and holding fees (PIH 2022-18). Optional and per PHA; 2026 budget pressure makes them scarcer.

reasons: City permit/licence required: Yes: STR rental licence (4-year term, $190 plus $25 business licence) plus a yearly principal-residence affidavit ($20) for stays of 29 days or fewer.
Primary-residence rule (no investor whole-home STR): Yes: must be the owner's principal residence (B.R.C. 10-1-1); owner must be a natural person, trust or nonprofit; tenants may not run STRs.
Zoning limits: Owner-occupied principal residences only; not allowed on a property with an ADU (10-3-19(o)).
Caps/density: Whole home: no day limit while it stays the owner's principal residence. An ADU may be an STR (up to 120 days a year) only if both the ADU and the STR licence predate Jan 3 2019.

permit.value: Yes: STR rental licence (4-year term, $190 plus $25 business licence) plus a yearly principal-residence affidavit ($20) for stays of 29 days or fewer.

primary_residence.value: Yes: must be the owner's principal residence (B.R.C. 10-1-1); owner must be a natural person, trust or nonprofit; tenants may not run STRs.

zones.value: Owner-occupied principal residences only; not allowed on a property with an ADU (10-3-19(o)).

caps.value: Whole home: no day limit while it stays the owner's principal residence. An ADU may be an STR (up to 120 days a year) only if both the ADU and the STR licence predate Jan 3 2019.

max_occupancy.value: No STR-specific guest cap found; occupancy follows the Property Maintenance Code (2024 IPMC Section 404 via B.R.C. 9-8-5 and 10-2-2).

taxes.value: Accommodations tax applies, filed quarterly through the Boulder Online Tax System; rate not stated on the licensing page.

listing_id.value: Yes: no one may advertise a short-term rental unless the ad shows the valid STR licence number; all rental ads must carry the rental licence number once assigned.

pending.value: None found: the city STR licensing page lists current rules (licence before advertising, 29-day maximum stay) and no pending changes.

state_preemption.value: No statewide STR preemption found; HB23-1287 (signed 2023) instead concerns county regulation of STRs. Home-rule cities such as Denver and Boulder license STRs themselves.
